notes.title: Taipei Game Show Version Released! "Who is the Defendant: Deliberately Rough" is Now Free to Play
notes.content:
[h2]The highly acclaimed, intriguingly artistic courtroom game! "Who is the Defendant: Deliberately Rough" is now available for free on Steam.[/h2]

https://youtu.be/qnV1jmTOOLw

"Who is the Defendant: Deliberately Rough" is a mystery game for PC, serving as a special exhibition edition of the developing game "The Real Face of a VTuber". Players take on the role of a prosecutor, accusing a malicious developer who showcased a game with deliberately rough art at a game exhibition. This has now been adapted into a special Steam version and released as a free game for interested players to experience.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44915859/76769eb81da715bf610e369cb3b69fbea8865722.png[/img]

Players will prosecute the malicious developer for "deceiving players with deliberately rough art," with the accused being none other than the development team, "Lilien Games". The game features amusing and "artistic" visuals, including a defense attorney unhappy with their appearance, a relieved prosecutor who wasn't targeted, and a witness bullied for having a complete sprite. The indictment's premise is sure to bring a smile to players' faces.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44915859/9f55b26888c3cebc9eccba7dfa3ba1c5d44792b9.png[/img]

As a special exhibition edition, the game itself boasts a high level of completeness. Players can name the protagonist, experience two courtroom phases ("Prosecution Witness Interrogation" and "Defense Witness Interrogation"), and achieve four different outcomes based on their actions, even earning a certificate of qualification. Despite its promotional nature, the game still offers an enjoyable experience.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44915859/86c7a322d09e509323eb5a775ad8996eab803456.png[/img]

This is a game designed to promote our main game. The new game "The Real Face of a VTuber" is a VTuber-themed mystery and puzzle game. However, due to the deadline for the game exhibition registration, the core VTuber artwork was not yet complete, leading to the creation of this special edition. Now, "The Real Face of a VTuber" has its Steam store page up and is scheduled for release in Q4 2024. We invite interested players to download "Who is the Defendant: Deliberately Rough" and get an early taste of the whimsical story style and courtroom debate gameplay.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44915859/0533bde9849b5fc61c36ea69d98283e76e4c9b4a.png[/img]

"Who is the Defendant: Deliberately Rough" is available in Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese, English, and Japanese, and is free to play on Steam.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2988880/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2871140/

notes.title: "The Real Faces of VTuber" - A VTuber-Themed Mystery Game!
notes.content:
Dear Followers,

Our new detective game now has its store page live!

"The Real Faces of Vtuber" is a text-based adventure mystery game themed around Vtubers and set in a courtroom. Players take on the role of a prosecutor investigating the murder of an entertainment company's CEO.

[previewyoutube=N5q79A245v8;full][/previewyoutube]

Set in a fictional Vtuber agency, the story unfolds with the CEO's mysterious death in his office. Suspicion falls on six employees who had access to the keys. Adding to the mystery, three claim to be the actual person, the "Nakanohito", behind the agency's virtual idol, "Kuripa", using their alibi of live streaming at the time of the crime. Who's lying? Identifying the true "Nakanohito" is crucial to crack the case.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41215530/ceb9ee01a5a4530392b809b2d8ae35bb4f3086a7.png[/img]

● A Courtroom Debate Game with a Prosecutor as the Protagonist
The game divides into 'Investigation' and 'Court Trial' phases. Players, wielding the prosecutor's authority, can summon suspects to the district prosecutor's office to unravel the case, scrutinize the contradictions in testimonies, direct the investigation's focus, and decide on the prosecution based on collected evidence. In court, players need to cooperate with the prosecution's witnesses and point out the inconsistencies in the defense witnesses' testimonies to achieve victory. The game has three different endings, hinging on the player's deductive prowess.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41215530/12aa1dae4c08a4fa8c591aa2608bba2182515b08.png[/img]

● Blending Vtuber Culture to Craft Dual Mysteries
of guessing both the criminal and the "Nakanohito". Through the process of investigation, players gain insights into the real world of Vtuber operations, including the dynamics between 'Illustrator moms' and 'Modeler dads', the complex relationships between talent managers and Vtubers, and issues like fanatical fans and cyberbullying. What is the murderer’s motive? Players will discover as they delve deeper.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41215530/8ab9868d7f7ffed6514b770c31ba62fecbc31cf3.png[/img]

● The Most Suitable Fictional Vtuber for Mystery Games
In the game, the fictional Vtuber "Kuripa" originates from the first computer virus "Creeper", which was harmless to computers, only replicating the text: "I'm The Creeper, Catch Me If You Can." This famous line not only echoes the concept of an elusive Virtual YouTuber but also fits the theme of a mystery game. What happens when you catch Kuripa? That's for the players to find out.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41215530/004b9d8a7d629d63ac54f7a3a2496cc405d445dd.png[/img]

Add to your wishlist, follow for the latest news!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2871140/

notes.title: Congratulations! Game wins award/version update.
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We have some great news to share!

Our game, "Who is the Criminal," has won the Silver Award in the Taiwan Indie Game category at the Taipei Game Show's "Game Star" competition! Congratulations to our team!

We never expected to win, especially with the game's retro style. To celebrate, we created a four-panel comic expressing our feelings about this achievement.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41215530/7728bced1742ea723db41d77e3973f4b19bd29ce.png[/img]

We're also offering a seven-day discount for those who are interested in buying the game but haven't yet taken the plunge. Don't miss out on this opportunity!

Additionally, many players have expressed their dissatisfaction with our game's loop system, and we've listened. We've optimized it, and now players can skip to the next chapter after completing a level.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41215530/fd488604653d0081e751c23ccd350a909a75b131.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41215530/659e81205cc32eb329a2174cc2f95619f4784968.png[/img]

Although it may not be the prettiest solution, we hope to improve it in future updates.

We're already planning our next project and can't wait to challenge you all with another set of mysteries! Please follow our social media pages for updates.

[url=https://www.facebook.com/LILIENGAMES]LILIEN GAMES FB[/url]

Lastly, we want to thank all our players for their support. We appreciate it from the bottom of our hearts.

Sincerely,

LILIEN GAMES
